propositions: Three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) in adapters/jira/acli_graph.py lack test coverage for multi-page pagination scenarios; existing tests only exercise single-page responses with isLast=True

The Cloud readers use an opaque cursor (nextPageToken + isLast) unlike DC's offset-based approach, creating a distinct defect class; termination logic must handle both isLast condition AND null/absent token independently

A repeated cursor token causes the readers to spin forever with no guard, as neither break condition fires when request and response become byte-identical; fail-open exception handling converts this into a silently partial map
Structural AST guard must prevent future unpaginated whole-project readers from being added to adapters/jira/*.py, as DC's guard scans only DC transport source and leaves Cloud's seam open
